newsitem.title: USA: Aeroflot flight called back to New York airport.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot flight called back to New York airport.

text.p: An Aeroflot plane that had just taken off from New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport on Friday was called back after officials found a note threatening the flight.
"Somebody found a scribbled note in one of our terminals," said Port Authority Police Sgt. John Mariano.
The plane, which took off at around 4 p.m. EDT (2000 GMT), returned to the terminal to be searched for a possible bomb, Mariano said.
He did not have information on the contents of the note, the size of plane or its destination. The Russian airline could not be reached for comment.
